notes.title: Free Locomotion movement mode now available!
notes.notes:
Hey VR Shooter Guns folks,

the FREE LOCOMOTION is finally here! Now you can run and fight through the space station like a real superhero!

You can activate the Free Locomotion mode instead of standard teleport movement in the settings.
You have options to adjust speed and size of the no-barf vignette (you can set it to 0 too).
How does it work? Well, just move your thumb over the thumbpad. Oculus users use the thumbsticks :)
 
Activate free locomotion in the "Settings - Input Settings" menu:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25716919/32747c00df4cb9249247c5614827919f4740e9ea.gif[/img]
 

We fixed a lot of minor issues, too, and also added new stuff:

We revamped the whole menu.

Also have a look at the tutorial section, we added some new info for you. And play the tutorial, it's really helpful to increase your score!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25716919/5cea871085abe095b774dd1af73cb83ddaef8959.gif[/img]

We redesigned the first level, so first-time players will have a better experience and die less often... don't forget to activate your checkpoints to keep your score after you died! If you don't and you die, you loose all your score you made since the start of the current level!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25716919/3b32ffc05f68f67d3825325fb46c839c3add2897.gif[/img]

A pumping heart will tell you that it's time to take cover and search for the next health pack

You can now skip the intro level easily with an option in the settings menu
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25716919/ab5686a341ed76aa77e0b8ed9593a900d5dab851.gif[/img]


Feedback, bugs, suggestions - post a comment or shoot us a mail vrsg@cykyria.com

Your Cykyria-Team!

notes.title: Free Locomotion Mode coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

We're working hard on the new Free Locomotion Mode update!

This mode will allow you to navigate freely in the space station, walk, run, strafe. No more immersion breaking teleport!

You get a first impression in this video:

[url=https://youtu.be/fWl0GpOe8nM]https://youtu.be/fWl0GpOe8nM[/url]


We have a beta ready and we want to get some feedback first before we release it to the public.

If anyone of you wants to test it out, please shoot us an email: 
vrsgbeta@cykyria.de

Then we'll give you access to the VRSG beta branch.

The feature update with free locomotion is scheduled for end of february.

Have fun!

 Ben from Cykyria

notes.title: VR Shooter Guns BLACK FRIDAY /MASSIVE/ SALE & UP-GRENADE!
notes.notes:
Hey VR Shooter Guns folks!

Today's /MASSIVE/ UP-GRENADE brings to your beloved VR Shooter Guns - wait for it - grenades!

Along with a /MASSIVE/ trove of tons of countless numerous bugfixes, enhancements and more:
[list]
[*] 30 Minute Run is the new default game mode
[*] listen to your own steps as you're walking around
[*] better hints for unskilled players
[*] better visuals
[*] better AI
[*] more FUN
[*] did we mention GRENADES?[/list] 

To use the grenades first collect a coin with a grenade, dropped by every 10th headshot. Then stretch out your arm and touch the holographic grenade. Hold the trigger to activate it, throw and release the trigger - BOOM!

Feedback, bugs, suggestions - post a comment or shoot us a mail vrsg@cykyria.com

Your Cykyria-Team!


P.S.: VR Shooter Guns is 50% off until Nov 28 - get it while it's hot!

notes.title: Friday the 13th update brings better bots and new CONTEST MODE!
notes.notes:
Hey fellow VR Shooter Guns folks!

Today's lucky patch brings you improved bots and new features in the settings menu and an improvement for Oculus Rift users.

New CONTEST MODE:
[list]
    [*]Create a highscore that is only visible to you
    [*]You can open it in the browser from within the game (you might need to switch back to the window to get the sound back)
    [*]Have a battle with your friends and see who's the best gunner!
    [*]Of course top scores go to the global highscore, too
[/list] 

New settings:
[list]
    [*]Oculus Rift: activate "Switch buttons" to put teleport onto button B (Y on left hand)
    [*]Set volume of sound effects
    [*]Set volume of background music
    [*]Set render quality (so you can lower the quality for older cards or up it for GTX1070 and higher
[*]You can now scroll the highscore (shoot up/down at the bottom right)
[/list] 


Feedback, bugs, suggestions - post a comment or shoot as a mail vrsg@cykyria.com

Your Cykyria-Team!
